notes.title: CultureHouse will be featured at Selected Indie Games 80 ~Gateway to SOWN2023~
notes.content:
CultureHouse has been selected as one of the indie game selection slots Selected Indie 80 at Tokyo Game Show 2023, which will be held from September 21st to 24th.
Along with this, CultureHouse will also appear in Selected Indie 80's introductory program Gateway to SOWN2023, which will be broadcast on August 29th.

[previewyoutube=ZmBjI4ym45U;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


At the same time as the release of the program, PS5 and Nintendo Switch will win Predict SOWN2023 Finalists Campaign is held. If you are interested, please check here.
